opening.argument: This is presented as an educational Coinbase Earn program: viewers are directed to watch lessons about digital assets and complete related quizzes or tasks, with cryptocurrency offered in return for participation. The content explains the learning process rather than advising viewers to invest, and it expressly states that "Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice." The invitation-based eligibility condition also limits what can be inferred: an invitation to earn 0x does not establish that every viewer can receive the asset. The visible lessons and questions reinforce that the central activity is learning about tokens and protocols, with rewards tied to that educational participation.

citations.quote: Users can go to a page, watch educational videos relating to those assets, and then complete tasks about those assets. In return, they'll earn cryptocurrency.
Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
